sources.document: Vishay document 80071, Data Formats for IR Remote Control, Rev. 2.3, 26-Jun-2024
sources.scope: Standard NEC pulse-distance format, leader, address/command inverse bytes and repeat context; not proof of an installed HS0038 or remote model
Active-low demodulated receiver output and electrical selection; its RC5/SIRC examples are not cited as NEC protocol definitions

reviewed_scope.mechanism: Explicit software NEC standard 8-bit/inverse or separately selected 16-bit address policy; command/inverse required in both
reviewed_scope.input: Copied public EXTI timestamps in one declared monotonic microsecond epoch. STRICT rejects COALESCED; explicit IRQ_OBSERVATION software reference retains sampled/uncertain quality and original flags, never physical capture completeness.
reviewed_scope.source_quality: Actual F407 PE2 IRQ dispatch marks every event COALESCED. Explicit software observation admission is distinct from flag-free source policy; LOSS always invalidates command/repeat history.
reviewed_scope.checked_irq_reference: STM32F407ZGT6 Qiming V4.1 PE2 software observation model only; no other Board/source/remote or physical qualification is inferred.
